name: hardening-dev-environment
description: Hardens the developer environment against npm supply chain attacks and prompt-injection-driven attacks on Claude Code. Generates pnpm 10.26+ config and migrates `npx` to `pnpm dlx`; generates `.claude/settings.json` `permissions.{deny, ask, allow}` rules tuned for an `acceptEdits`-based operating mode, with hard-guarantee deny on credential reads, persistence-target writes, and privilege-escalation Bash; bundles PreToolUse hooks that block sensitive Bash reads and `package.json` `scripts` tampering, and a PostToolUse hook that marks non-vendor `WebFetch` results as untrusted external data.
